absurd_paradox.description: Shocking compute waste, paradoxical inefficiency, or inverted expectations directly from the paper.

shock_metric.description: Explosive benchmark disparity or order-of-magnitude leap (e.g. 10x faster or major efficiency gain).

villain_first.description: Immediate identification of the mechanical bottleneck suffocating modern AI.

curiosity_trap.description: Revealing hidden mechanics behind complex algorithms and architectures.

textbook_lecture.description: BANNED: Academic openings ('Today we explore...', 'In this paper...'). Severe viewer drop-off.

BlueprintSplitFlow.recommendation: EXCELLENT for bifurcated flows, dual-pass verification, or router dispatch.

BlueprintGridMemory.recommendation: STRONG for VRAM, SRAM, KV cache tiling, and matrix memory walls.

BlueprintChalkboardCodeBlock.recommendation: HIGH RETENTION with developer audiences when active line sweep is synced to audio.

BlueprintPipelineStages.recommendation: SOLID for multistage pipelines (prefill, decode, verify).

BlueprintTreeHierarchy.recommendation: GOOD for speculative verification trees and Monte Carlo search.

generic_sine_wave.recommendation: BANNED: Flat generic animation trigger. Causes immediate cognitive drop-off.
